findings.title: Uncaught asynchronous stdin EPIPE during startup
findings.observed: Exact startHost with real Node child whose read end closes: unhandled Socket error and process exit 1.
findings.minimum_correction: Handle asynchronous startup-input errors before writing; return a redacted bounded failure and perform cleanup while preserving possible delivery.

findings.title: Asynchronous spawn ENOENT falsely reports startup delivered
findings.observed: No executable/process exists, but HostStart failure reports delivered:true; caller retains requested_unknown.
findings.minimum_correction: Distinguish known spawn failure from a started child with doubtful delivery; known failure returns delivered:false.

executed.environment_note: Nested spawnSync metadata carried EPERM despite actual child execution/status; preserved separately, not a product finding. Direct execution reproduced EPIPE independently.

other_transport_disposition: No additional blocker established in this bounded source review; actual HTTP/Windows integration not executed.
